name: 超级形态
description: 本回合索尼克使用动能技能不重置动能，回合结束后保留。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece;c.statusTags=(c.statusTags||[]).filter(function(t){return t.type!=='preserve-momentum';});c.statusTags.push({id:'preserve-momentum-'+c.instanceId,type:'preserve-momentum',name:'超级形态',stacks:1,currentDuration:1,untilTurn:context.battle.turn.turnNumber});return {success:true,message:'本回合动能不会被消耗'};}
